body.x: GREEN SYSTEM (CEO Lee Yeong-lan) unveiled a standby power blocking application system in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).

The Smart Home Power Control System, which the company showcased at CES 2016, can save energy as it monitors standby power and collects power usage statistics by using a standby power-blocking outlet.
This system can be also managed and controlled by a mobile application. Users can register outlets and electronic devices and utilize a timer function.
One can check the level of each socket’s power, and each outlet of a multi outlet shows its power state by using different LED lights. The system also provides an app monitoring function.
GREEN SYSTEM CEO Lee Yeong-lan said: “We are happy to showcase our energy saving systems at CES 2016. The standby power blocking application is mobile based, so it is convenient to manage.”
The company is focusing on energy saving application systems for efficient energy management. In particular, it is taking the lead in the research of mobile-based control management software.

DIP prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the reinforcement project for quality capability of the smart knowledge service, which is a promotional project for regional-specialized businesses supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th
